text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's awesome! Look, they're about 
to spill over my arms!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm glad I stopped by here!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. You really do go beyond my 
imagination, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Keep showing me all the different sides of 
you, and keep blowing me away!
